coverage.review_method: Current official project pages, repositories, docs, model cards and author papers; prior catalog used for discovery only. No new external runtime or frontier inference benchmark was executed.
coverage.unknown_fields_mean: Not stated or not tied to the reported timing in the reviewed source; not a claim that no benchmark exists anywhere.

our_result.timing_scope: generate_media task wall spans include processing and saving; process startup is outside these task clocks; first task can include model loading and shape preparation
our_result.full_coordinator_failure: Resource process-identity guard before final exit

published_local_speed_rows.timing_scope_and_limits: Publisher E2E; distilled Wan1.3B, FP4 linear/attention, no CFG, tiny decoder. Audio/startup/compile timing boundary NR.

published_local_speed_rows.name: TurboDiffusion / TurboWan2.1-1.3B
published_local_speed_rows.cold_warm_state: Not stated for the timed example
published_local_speed_rows.timing_scope_and_limits: Own README: 1.9s E2E. Benchmark settings are not tied to nearby examples. FastVideo reproduction: 6.10s; unmatched.

published_local_speed_rows.timing_scope_and_limits: Author E2E table; four-step NVFP4/sparse recipe. Frames, audio, startup and warm state NR.

published_local_speed_rows.name: LightX2V / LightWan2.2-A14B 720p
published_local_speed_rows.timing_scope_and_limits: Author E2E table; four-step NVFP4/sparse recipe. Frames, audio, startup and warm state NR.

published_local_speed_rows.name: FastVideo / FastH3 Omni
published_local_speed_rows.cold_warm_state: One warmup, then three measured seeds; conditioning caches disabled
published_local_speed_rows.timing_scope_and_limits: One-image reference task. Client wall time through completed MP4 includes reference encoding, generation and decoding; model loading/server startup excluded. Different model/runtime recipe and eight GPUs.

published_local_speed_rows.name: NVIDIA Sol Engine / MiniMax H3
published_local_speed_rows.timing_scope_and_limits: Publisher E2E with stock checkpoint plus sparse attention/cross-step cache. VAE/fixed costs included; file-saving boundary not independently checked. Different canvas and 50 steps.

published_local_speed_rows.name: LTX-Video paper
published_local_speed_rows.timing_scope_and_limits: Author paper abstract gives generation time, without full startup/encoding/audio boundary. Historical LTX-Video model, not LTX-2.5 or H3.

published_local_speed_rows.name: FramePack author report
published_local_speed_rows.cold_warm_state: Not specified for the per-frame report
published_local_speed_rows.timing_scope_and_limits: Next-frame-section throughput: 1.5 seconds/frame with TeaCache, 2.5 unoptimized. Author explicitly warns TeaCache can change output. Not first-frame or completed-file latency.

published_local_speed_rows.name: StreamDiffusionV2 headline
published_local_speed_rows.cold_warm_state: Streaming throughput; cold-start boundary not pinned in headline
published_local_speed_rows.timing_scope_and_limits: Video-to-video streaming without TensorRT/quantization. Headline step count/resolution NR; supported settings include 1-4 steps. FPS/first-frame latency exclude a demonstrated completed-file boundary.

published_local_speed_rows.name: HunyuanVideo-1.5 step-distilled I2V
published_local_speed_rows.timing_scope_and_limits: Official release says within 75 seconds end-to-end; supports 8 or 12 recommended steps and optional 4. Exact timed schedule, clip length and saving/startup boundaries are not pinned there.

published_local_speed_rows.name: Wan2.2 TI2V-5B reference statement

hardware.gpu: consumer GPU; exact benchmark SKU not specified

published_local_speed_rows.timing_scope_and_limits: Official README says under nine minutes without specific optimization. It separately supports 24GB devices such as RTX4090; that is not proof of the exact benchmark GPU.

published_local_speed_rows.name: VDN-H3 / SGLang Diffusion
published_local_speed_rows.timing_scope_and_limits: Author repository reports completed-video end-to-end time. Hybrid attention/adapters and MXFP8 change the model recipe; the headline does not separately identify audio inclusion in this timing. Not an unchanged-H3 comparison.

frontier_catalog.name: Google Veo 3.1 / current migration routes

frontier_catalog.limits: The 11-second to 6-minute service range remains on that documentation page; no matched model variant, GPU, warm state or queue-free finished-download timing is supplied. Treat it as documented service guidance, not an active-preview benchmark.

comparison_rules: Finished audiovisual task latency, denoiser time, first-frame latency, sustained streaming FPS and service queue latency are separate measurements.
Different model weights/distillation/quantization/attention/decoder/steps/resolution/frame count/audio/hardware/input-cache conditions prevent an attributable runtime ranking.
All external numerical values are publisher-reported and were not reproduced on this workstation.
No frontier-quality, exact-output or one-second-finished-audiovisual guarantee is established.
No model weights, private prompts, reference media, generated media, raw operational logs or credentials are included.
